rationale: The expected value is positive but not high: v20.93 showed the same two heldout rows are sensitive to context/name drift, while v20.95 improves the packet with eight blind non-target hydrated candidates from sidecars and keeps target proof, gold state, replay, and training flags false. Success can come from either a strict same-target row or an informative hard-negative contrast, which raises p_success versus strict-only replay. The main uncertainty is whether Franklin/Noether hydration fixed the actual local names and theorem orientations without crossing the v20.94 quarantine boundary.
